newsitem.title: USA: American Eco, Chempower complete merger.
newsitem.headline: American Eco, Chempower complete merger.

text.p: American Eco Corp and Chempower Inc said the companies have completed their merger agreement with American Eco paying US$6.20 a share for Chempower's 7.8 million shares.

American Eco funded the acquisition by a private placement of US $15.0 million 9.5 percent 10-year convertible debentures to U.S. institutional investors, American Eco said. Chempower and American Eco issued separate statements about the deal.
The debentures are convertible after 181 days into the common shares of American Eco at a price based on a formula of the market price of the shares at the time of conversion, American Eco said.
Certain of the principal shareholders of Chempower agreed to take US$19.9 million of one year notes in lieu of cash, American Eco said.
